name: Prometheus (host metrics)
description: Reads the processor, memory, swap, disks, network traffic, load and uptime of hosts from a Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir or Thanos that already scrapes them (node_exporter for Linux, BSD and macOS; windows_exporter for Windows), so a host that cannot be probed needs no second agent. The store's own history fills the graphs. Read-only: only GET requests to /api/v1; nothing is sent to the hosts.
author: Netlens
supports: windows_exporter (answers written from its documentation; not tested)
VictoriaMetrics, Mimir, Thanos Query (same API; not tested)

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.304 or newer (plugin kind metrics).
